```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(ggrepel)
```

```{r set-directories, include=FALSE}
res_dir <- "../results/s06_b_f_stats/"
```

# Load

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt")
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

This script uses admixtools @maierAdmixtoolsInferringDemographic2024 to calculate F3 and F4 statistics, using the full global dataset, comprising of `r nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` individuals and `r count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` loci.

# Remove all populations with only one individual

```{r}
pop_tbl <- table(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)
to_remove <- which(pop_tbl == 1)
to_remove_pops <- names(to_remove)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(!population %in% to_remove_pops)
```

# Group by population

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Create f2 blocks directory

```{r}
if (dir.exists("../data/intermediate/f2")) {
  f2_dir <- "../data/intermediate/f2"
} else {
  dir.create("../data/intermediate/f2")
  gt_extract_f2(mad_bor_g1000_sum,
    outdir = "../data/intermediate/f2",
    fst = FALSE,
    n_cores = 10
  )
  f2_dir <- "../data/intermediate/f2"
}
```

# Read in precomputed f2's

```{r, warning = FALSE}
f2_blocks <- f2_from_precomp(f2_dir,
  afprod = FALSE
)
dim(f2_blocks)
count_snps(f2_blocks)
```

# Test for admixture: F3(Malagasy; Asian, African)

```{r echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gc()
```


```{r echo = FALSE}
all_pops <- unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)

malagasy <- c(
  "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", # MerinaA, MerinaB
  "Betsileo", "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea"
)
asian <- c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor", "KHV", "CHS", "PJL", "BEB")

african <- setdiff(all_pops, c(malagasy, asian))

# Running test directly crashes R session, instead we can run in a loop
results <- vector("list", length(african))
names(results) <- african
for (c_pop in african) {
  message("Running C = ", c_pop)
  results[[c_pop]] <- qp3pop(
    f2_blocks,
    malagasy,
    asian,
    c_pop
  )
  gc()
}
```

```{r}
test <- do.call(rbind, results)

colnames(test) <- c("Malagasy", "Asian", "African", "est", "se", "z", "p")

test$Asian <- sub("BOR", "Borneo", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("CHS", "Han, China", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("KHV", "Kinh, Vietnam", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("PJL", "Punjabi, Pakistan", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("BEB", "Bengali, Bengal", test$Asian)

test$African <- sub("ESN", "Esan, Nigeria", test$African)
test$African <- sub("YRI", "Yoruba, Nigeria", test$African)
test$African <- sub("GWD", "Mandinka, The Gambia", test$African)
test$African <- sub("LWK", "Luhye, Kenya", test$African)
test$African <- sub("MSL", "Mende, Sierra Leone", test$African)

test$Malagasy <- sapply(
  strsplit(test$Malagasy, "_"),
  function(x) paste(x, collapse = " ")
)

print(test)
```

Admixture f3 statistics were used in the configuration f3(Malagasy; Asian, African) to examine which comparative African and Asian populations show the greatest similarity to the ‘source’ populations of the Malagasy.

```{r}
write.table(test,
  file = paste0(res_dir, "f3_results_all_combinations"),
  row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t"
)
```

# Examine cases where f3 value is not negative

```{r}
test <- read.table(paste0(res_dir, "f3_results_all_combinations"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t"
)
fail <- which(test$est > 0)
test_fail <- test[fail, ]

test_fail$poor_fit <- NA

check_refs <- function(test_fail) {
  poor_fit_asian_pop <- c("Punjabi, Pakistan", "Bengali, Bengal")

  # check if this row contains any of the poor fit populations
  if (any(test_fail["Asian"] %in% poor_fit_asian_pop) || any(grepl("SouthAfrica", test_fail["African"]))) {
    # add "Yes" to the poor_fit column
    test_fail["poor_fit"] <- "Yes"
  } else {
    # add "No" to the poor_fit column
    test_fail["poor_fit"] <- "No"
  }
}
test_fail$poor_fit <- apply(test_fail, check_refs, MARGIN = 1)
any(test_fail$poor_fit == "No")
```

All use either Punjabi, Pakistan or Bengali, Bengal as the Asian reference population, or a mixed ancestry South African population as the African reference population, which are likely to be poor fits for the source populations of the Malagasy.

```{r}
failz <- which(test$z > -2)
test_failz <- test[failz, ]
test_failz$poor_fit <- NA
check_refs <- function(test_failz) {
  poor_fit_asian_pop <- c("Punjabi, Pakistan", "Bengali, Bengal")

  # check if this row contains any of the poor fit populations
  if (any(test_failz["Asian"] %in% poor_fit_asian_pop) || any(grepl("SouthAfrica", test_failz["African"]))) {
    # add "Yes" to the poor_fit column
    test_failz["poor_fit"] <- "Yes"
  } else {
    # add "No" to the poor_fit column
    test_failz["poor_fit"] <- "No"
  }
}
test_failz$poor_fit <- apply(test_failz, check_refs, MARGIN = 1)
any(test_failz$poor_fit == "No")
```

# F3 values for each Malagasy population descending all combinations

```{r}
# update labels
test <- test %>% mutate(Malagasy = case_when(
  Malagasy == "Sakalava Tsimihety" ~ "Sakalava/Tsimihety",
  TRUE ~ Malagasy
))
test <- test %>% mutate(Malagasy = case_when(
  Malagasy == "Diego" ~ "Diego Mixed",
  TRUE ~ Malagasy
))

test_grouped <- test %>%
  select(est, se, z, Malagasy, Asian, African) %>%
  reframe(est = est, se = se, z, Malagasy, Asian, African)

test_grouped$highlight <- "NA"
# find rows with"Mozambique_Chopi" and"Borneo" as references
test_grouped$highlight[which(test_grouped$African == "Mozambique_Chopi" & test_grouped$Asian == "Borneo")] <- "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi"
test_grouped$highlight <- as.factor(test_grouped$highlight)

test_grouped %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  arrange(desc(est)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = est, y = reorder(Malagasy, est),
    color = highlight, shape = highlight, alpha = highlight
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "f3 (Malagasy; Borneo, Mozambique_Chopi)", y = NULL,
    color = element_blank(), shape = element_blank(),
    alpha = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "NA" = 19, # "Borneo" = 3, "Mozambique_Chopi" = 15,
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi" = 17
    ),
    breaks = c(
      # "Borneo", "Mozambique_Chopi",
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "NA" = "grey", # "Borneo" = "lightpink", "Mozambique_Chopi" = "lightblue",
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi" = "purple"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      # "Borneo", "Mozambique_Chopi",
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi"
    )
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c(
      "NA" = 0.7, # "Borneo" = 0.7, "Mozambique_Chopi" = 0.7,
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi" = 1
    ),
    breaks = c(
      # "Borneo", "Mozambique_Chopi",
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(res_dir, "F3_all_combinations.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300
)
```

# F4 ratio

To estimate the proportion of each ancestry source within the Malagasy population, we will use an f4 ratio in the following configurations:

f4(GBR,Gorilla;Malagasy,Borneo)/f4(GBR,Chimpanzee;Esan,Borneo)

f4(GBR,Gorilla;Malagasy,Esan)/f4(GBR,Chimpanzee;Borneo,Esan)

# Load

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt")
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```


# Split Merina

```{r}
qmats <- read_q_files("../data/intermediate/admixture")

fam <- read.table(
  "../data/intermediate/admixture/admixture_supervised_subset.fam",
  header = FALSE
)

qmats$id <- fam$V2

# subset mad_bor_g1000_sum to only individuals in qmats$id
mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  filter(id %in% qmats$id)

# tidy with the gt
mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 2, run = 1),
  data = mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub
)
# filter to merina
merina <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub %>% filter(population == "Merina")

# save output
saveRDS(merina, file = paste0(res_dir, "merina_qmats.rds"))

# find which .Q column represents Asian ancestry
asian_ancestry_q <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub %>%
  filter(population == "Borneo") %>%
  # Get median value of Q1 and Q2
  summarise(.Q1 = median(.Q1), .Q2 = median(.Q2)) %>%
  # Pivot in order to subset
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(".Q1", ".Q2"),
    names_to = "column_name",
    values_to = "median_val"
  ) %>%
  # Find the row with the max value
  slice_max(median_val, n = 1) %>%
  # get the column name
  pull(column_name)

# split groups
merina$population <- ifelse(merina %>% select(all_of(asian_ancestry_q)) > 0.5,
  "MerinaA",
  "MerinaB"
)
merina <- merina[, c("id", "population")]

# match V2 and merina$id and replace the population column in merina_fam with
# the population column in merina
matching_m <- match(mad_bor_g1000_sum$id, merina$id)
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m),
  merina$population[matching_m], mad_bor_g1000_sum$population
)

# count number of MerinaA
cat(
  "Merina group > 0.5",
  length(which(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "MerinaA"))
)
cat(
  "Merina group < 0.5",
  length(which(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "MerinaB"))
)
```

# F4 ratio: estimating the proportion of African admixture

Sister taxon and outgroup on the left, target in the centre, and sister population and source of admixture on the right.

```{r}
malagasy <- c(
  "Betsimisaraka", "MerinaA", "MerinaB", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety",
  "Betsileo", "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea"
)

pop_matrix <-
  as.matrix(data.frame("GBR", "chimp_ref", malagasy, "Borneo", "ESN"))

qp4_african_p <- qpf4ratio(f2_blocks, pop_matrix)

qp4_african_p$pop3 <- factor(qp4_african_p$pop3,
  levels = c(
    "Betsimisaraka", "MerinaA", "MerinaB", "Diego",
    "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo",
    "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea"
  )
)
# order by qp4_african_p$pop3 levels
qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>% mutate(pop3 = forcats::fct_inorder(pop3))
# round alpha to 1 decimal place
qp4_african_p

# save output
write.table(
  file = paste0(res_dir, "f4_ratio_african_admixture"),
  qp4_african_p, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# update labels
# rename qp4_african_p$pop3 "Sakalava Tsimihety" to "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>% mutate(pop3 = case_when(
  pop3 == "Sakalava_Tsimihety" ~ "Sakalava/Tsimihety",
  TRUE ~ pop3
))
# rename qp4_african_p$pop3 "Diego" to "Diego Mixed"
qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>% mutate(pop3 = case_when(
  pop3 == "Diego" ~ "Diego Mixed",
  TRUE ~ pop3
))
# rename qp4_african_p$pop3 "MerinaA" to "Merina A"
qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>% mutate(pop3 = case_when(
  pop3 == "MerinaA" ~ "Merina A",
  TRUE ~ pop3
))
# rename qp4_african_p$pop3 "MerinaB" to "Merina B"
qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>% mutate(pop3 = case_when(
  pop3 == "MerinaB" ~ "Merina B",
  TRUE ~ pop3
))

qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>%
  arrange(desc(alpha)) %>%
  mutate(pop3 = forcats::fct_inorder(pop3))
ggplot(qp4_african_p, aes(x = alpha, y = pop3, colour = pop3, fill = pop3)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = paste("Admixture proportion \u03b1"), y = NULL,
    colour = "Malagasy population", fill = "Malagasy population"
  ) +
  guides(colour = "none", fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )
ggsave(
  filename = paste0(res_dir, "F4_African_source.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
pop_matrix <-

qp4_asian_p$pop3 <- factor(
  qp4_asian_p$pop3,
  c(
    "Betsimisaraka", "MerinaA", "MerinaB", "Diego",
    "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Temoro",
    "Vezo", "Mikea"
  )
)

qp4_asian_p <- qp4_asian_p %>% mutate(pop3 = forcats::fct_inorder(pop3))
qp4_asian_p
```


Merina and Betsileo are highest, as expected.
